priority.summary: Fermi Inc. discloses the immediate resignation of director Miles Everson, effective July 10, 2026, due to a disagreement over access to company books and records and the delegation of responsibility for overseeing financing transactions to the Finance Committee. Everson's resignation was submitted in a letter, which is attached to the filing as an exhibit, and he did not serve on any committee of the Board at the time of his resignation. The company believes Everson was granted full access to its books and records, except for materials related to pending litigation involving Toby Neugebauer, whom Everson represented on the Board.

general.title: Warsh Tells Traders to Watch the Data. They Still Follow the Fed
general.summary: Early on Oct. 14, just hours before the release of a much-anticipated report on US inflation, TD Securities’ Gennadiy Goldberg recommended that clients bet against a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike later in the month. The logic was that inflation would likely be benign enough to justify a hold. Equally important, a slew of Fed officials had spent days pushing back against expectations for an imminent move.

general.title: Inside The Two Argentinas Under Javier Milei
general.summary: President Javier Milei has brought inflation down and opened Argentina to more investment, helping fuel a boom in energy and other export industries. But manufacturing, retail and small businesses are struggling, leaving many Argentines feeling that the recovery is passing them by. One year before the election, Milei’s biggest test may be unifying an increasingly fragmented economy. (Source: Bloomberg)
